purpose: Teach: 谷口/柳沢/奥田/新井/荒木/浅野/村山/大田

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 当社、新任の谷口部長を歓迎しろ
lines.en: Welcome our new department head, Taniguchi.
lines.style: Clipped authority. Measured pace, no softening. Each phrase lands distinct. The tone of someone used to being heard the first time.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。営業の柳沢課長の出張日程を整えます
lines.en: Understood. I'll arrange Sales Manager Yanagisawa's travel schedule.
lines.style: Quiet competence. Steady, responsive. No flourish — just the next item confirmed and filed. Brief, efficient.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 当社、技術担当の奥田主任にプロジェクトを任せろ
lines.en: Assign the new project to Okuda in Technical.
lines.style: Direct command, no hesitation. Slightly faster than the first — momentum building. Confident in the instruction.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。新井広報の戦略を採用します
lines.en: Understood. I'll adopt Arai's PR strategy.
lines.style: Brisk acknowledgment. Clipped at the edges. Moving to the next task — efficient, unsentimental.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 当社、人事の荒木様の昇格を進めろ
lines.en: Move forward with Araki's promotion in HR.
lines.style: Command tone, unflinching. Slight pause before the final phrase — weight on the decision itself. Not asking, deciding.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。経理の浅野様に予算策定を依頼します
lines.en: Understood. I'll request Budget Planning from Asano in Accounting.
lines.style: Steady, methodical reply. The rhythm of tasks being checked off. Quiet competence underscoring each name.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 当社、海外担当の村山部長と連携しろ
lines.en: Coordinate with Murayama, our Overseas department head.
lines.style: Clear directive, slightly formal. Even cadence. The word 'coordinate' lands with intent — partnership, not subordination.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。法務の大田様に契約書確認を依頼します
lines.en: Understood. I'll request contract review from Ota in Legal.
lines.style: Final confirmation. Calm, settled. Slightly slower — wrapping up the briefing. Concluding without ceremony.
